## Summary

Episodes and livestreams already ship 16:9 cover art (`coverImage: "/static/covers/EPxx-cover.png"`), but their social preview fell back to the generated blogpost-style card. This wires the covers through to the Open Graph / Twitter image (Option A from the approved plan in #90).

## Changes

- **`quartz/plugins/transformers/frontmatter.ts`** — add `"coverImage"` to the `socialImage` alias list so existing `coverImage` frontmatter populates `data.socialImage`. (`EpisodeCarousel` still reads `coverImage` directly, so the index cards are unaffected.)
- **`quartz/plugins/emitters/ogImage.tsx`** — resolve site-absolute paths (`/static/covers/EP06-cover.png`) as-is instead of prefixing `/static/` again (which produced `/static//static/...`). Bare filenames still resolve against `/static/`; full external URLs are unchanged.

Because the emitter already skips `.webp` generation when `socialImage` is set, cover'd pages now serve the raw cover and other pages keep the generated card.

## Verification

Ran a full `npx quartz build`:

- EP06 → `og:image` = `https://augmented-mind.github.io/static/covers/EP06-cover.png`, no `ep06-og-image.webp` emitted, and no `og:image:width/height` (correct, since the cover isn't 1200×630).
- LS01 → its `LS01-cover.png`.
- `index`, guest, topic, and listing pages → still generate the `.webp` card with width/height meta.

Prettier passes on both files; no new TypeScript errors.

Note: the pre-existing `og:image:type` value renders as `image/.png` (leading dot from `getFileExtension`) and affects the generated `.webp` too — left as-is since it's out of scope for this issue.

Closes #90

## AI Review Synthesis > Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**. > Requested by @lolipopshock. Here is the unified review synthesis. ## Summary of PR/Issue This PR wires episode and livestream cover art into the Open Graph / Twitter social image, implementing **Option A** from the approved plan in issue #90. Episodes already ship 16:9 covers (`coverImage: "/static/covers/EPxx-cover.png"`) but their social preview fell back to the generated blogpost-style card. The change adds `"coverImage"` to the `socialImage` alias list in `frontmatter.ts`, and fixes `ogImage.tsx` so site-absolute paths resolve as-is instead of being double-prefixed to `/static//static/...`. Because the emitter already skips `.webp` generation when `socialImage` is set, cover'd pages now serve the raw cover while all other pages keep the generated card — with zero per-episode edits. ## Review One reviewer evaluated this PR and verified it end-to-end against every consumer (carousel, `Head.tsx`, emitter, RSS/sitemap), finding no bugs or regressions. The change is minimal, faithful to the approved scope, and correct for all real inputs; every finding is optional INFO-level polish with nothing blocking. | Issue | Severity | Description | | -- | -- | -- | | Empty `if` branch is a readability smell | INFO | `ogImage.tsx:152` — the `isAbsoluteURL` case is now an empty block containing only a comment. Functionally correct; inverting the guard reads cleaner. Optional. | | Pre-existing malformed `og:image:type` | INFO | `ogImage.tsx:162` — `image/${getFileExtension(...)}` yields `image/.png` (leading dot). Pre-existing and out of scope for #90; a one-line fix is cheap since the hunk is already here, but leaving it is defensible. | | No unit coverage for new path-resolution branches | INFO | The three-way resolution lives inline in the JSX hook, so it isn't unit-testable without extraction. Acceptable given the small surface and full `npx quartz build` verification. Optional. | ## Progress - Faithfully implements **Option A** as approved in issue #90; reuses the existing `socialImage` escape hatch rather than a parallel mechanism. - Reviewer verified all no-regression claims: `EpisodeCarousel` unaffected (`coalesceAliases` is non-destructive), no double `og:image` (`Head.tsx:35` `usesCustomOgImage` skips the fallback), no dangling `.webp` references, correct path resolution (`baseUrl` has no protocol/trailing slash), and safe precedence (`coverImage` placed last). - PR includes concrete `npx quartz build` output: EP06 and LS01 serve their covers with no `.webp` emitted; `index`/guest/topic/listing pages keep the generated card with width/height meta. - Omitting `og:image:width/height` for covers is a confirmed-correct deliberate tradeoff (covers aren't 1200×630; crawlers measure and Twitter `summary_large_image` crops 16:9 cleanly) — no action needed. - The `image/.png` mime issue is explicitly acknowledged in the PR description as pre-existing and out of scope. - Posted one optional, non-blocking inline nit on `ogImage.tsx:152` (empty-`if` branch). No prior inline comments or review threads existed, so nothing was replied to, resolved, or minimized. ## Issue Details
Empty if branch is a readability smell (ogImage.tsx:152) **Cause:** The refactor turned the `isAbsoluteURL` case into an empty block whose only content is a `// full external URL, use as-is` comment, with the real work in the `else if` / `else` branches. **Candidate solutions:** Invert the guard so all three cases live in one assignment and no empty block remains: ```ts if (!isAbsoluteURL(userDefinedOgImagePath)) { userDefinedOgImagePath = userDefinedOgImagePath.startsWith("/") ? `https://${baseUrl}${userDefinedOgImagePath}` // site-absolute : `https://${baseUrl}/static/${userDefinedOgImagePath}` // bare filename } ``` **Comments:** Purely optional readability polish — the current form is functionally correct. Flagged inline on line 152 as non-blocking.
Pre-existing malformed og:image:type (ogImage.tsx:162) **Cause:** `image/${getFileExtension(ogImagePath) ?? "png"}` produces `image/.png` because `getFileExtension` returns the extension *with* the leading dot. This also affects the generated `.webp` path and predates this PR. **Candidate solutions:** `image/${getFileExtension(ogImagePath)?.slice(1) ?? "png"}`. Cheap since the diff already touches this hook, but legitimately outside issue #90's scope. **Comments:** PR description already flags this as pre-existing and out of scope; reviewer agrees it should not block. Left as a maintainer's-discretion call rather than an inline comment because line 162 sits outside the changed hunk.
No unit coverage for new path-resolution branches **Cause:** The new absolute-URL / site-absolute / bare-filename resolution logic lives inline in the emitter's JSX `additionalHead` hook, so it can't be unit-tested without extraction, even though `quartz/util/path.test.ts` exists for path utilities. **Candidate solutions:** Extract a `resolveSocialImagePath(path, baseUrl)` helper and add `path.test.ts`-style cases for the three branches. Optional defense-in-depth. **Comments:** Acceptable to skip given the small surface, verified behavior, and the full build check in the PR.
## Recommended Next Step `HUMAN_DECISION` — the PR is correct and mergeable as-is; the only open items are optional style/scope judgment calls (empty-`if` cleanup, pre-existing mime nit) that a maintainer may fold in or ship past, so no automated fix pass is warranted. ## Final Verdict `SHIP` ## Action Items _No blocking or required changes — this PR is safe to merge as-is. The items below are optional polish at the maintainer's discretion; none are required and none should trigger an automated fix pass._ - [ ] (Optional) `ogImage.tsx:152` — invert the `isAbsoluteURL` guard to remove the empty `if` block (readability only). - [ ] (Optional, out of scope) `ogImage.tsx:162` — fix the pre-existing `image/.png` mime type via `getFileExtension(...)?.slice(1)` if this hook is revisited. - [ ] (Optional) Extract `resolveSocialImagePath(path, baseUrl)` and add unit tests covering the three resolution branches. --- `claude` | `claude-opus-4-8` | `max` | `GitHub Actions 1000005125`
